title: Walmart Product Search - Prices, Sellers & Stock
description: Minimal input {"queries": ["wireless headphones"], "maxResults": 3, "maxPagesPerSource": 1}. $0.008 per parsed page plus $0.002 per delivered product. Parsed empty/filtered pages are paid. No start fee; use maxTotalChargeUsd as a run option.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Required search phrases, e.g. ["project management"]. Up to 20 queries, visited in order. One maxResults cap is shared across the whole run. Use specific terms in any language. Successful parsed pages and delivered matching rows are separate paid events.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the ENTIRE run after filters, deduplication and exclusions. Default 20; range 1–1000. Earlier targets can fill this cap. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in the Apify run options for a dollar cap; it is not an input field.

titleContains.title: Title contains
titleContains.description: Optional case-insensitive OR substring filter on the video/product title, e.g. ["wireless", "bluetooth"]. Empty disables. Filters run before maxResults; inspected pages still carry page fees. No extra filter fee.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Minimum displayed USD price, e.g. 5. 0 disables. Source offer conditions still apply. Missing prices fail an active price filter. Filters before maxResults. No extra filter fee.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Maximum displayed USD price, e.g. 50. 0 disables. This is not a checkout-total or shipping-inclusive limit. Missing prices fail an active filter; minimum must not exceed a positive maximum. No extra filter fee.

minRating.title: Min rating
minRating.description: Minimum source star rating from 0 to 5, e.g. 4.5. 0 disables. Missing ratings fail a positive threshold. No sentiment is inferred. Filters before maxResults; no extra filter fee.

sellers.title: Sellers
sellers.description: Optional exact, case-insensitive seller names, e.g. ["Walmart.com"]. Copy seller values from an initial result. Empty accepts all sellers. Missing seller names fail an active filter. No extra filter fee.

onlyInStock.title: Only in stock
onlyInStock.description: false (default) keeps all stock labels. true keeps only source-confirmed IN_STOCK search cards. This is not store-specific or ZIP-code inventory. Missing availability fails the filter. No extra filter fee.

excludeSponsored.title: Exclude sponsored
excludeSponsored.description: false (default) keeps sponsored and organic cards. true keeps only source-confirmed organic cards; unknown sponsorship is also excluded. Filters before maxResults; no extra filter fee.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Max pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Maximum successfully parsed result pages per query/video, default 2; range 1–20. Each page has a fee even if filters leave zero rows. Bootstrap/sort requests are included in that fee. This limits search depth, not a guarantee of enough matching results.

excludeIds.title: Exclude ids
excludeIds.description: Row id values from a previous dataset, e.g. [] on the first run. Up to 5,000 IDs. Skips matching IDs even if their content changed. Excluded rows have no row fee; parsed-page fees still apply. Keep IDs in your workflow; no history is stored automatically.

excludeContentHashes.title: Exclude content hashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior content_hash values, e.g. [] initially. Up to 5,000 SHA-256 values. Skips unchanged records while allowing changed prices/text/metrics through. Collection time, query, page position and images do not affect hashes. Caller-managed history; parsed-page fees apply.
